name: Maker Hip
author: Maker Hip
tagline: eight tracks of sounds, easy to follow
description: A test build. Eight tracks, each with one sound from a single list of 78 built-in sounds (drums, bass, keys, pads, leads, effects), all at the same loudness; the keys play the selected track; four knobs shape it (pitch, a DJ filter, decay, level); a basic 16-step page; a limiter on the output. Nothing is saved yet.
credits: Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp (MPL-2.0), from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hugelton Instruments). Sounds: Maker Hip's own Rock kit and FM bank; the Hugelton Sample Pack by Leo Kuroshita (CC0); Versilian Studios VCSL (CC0); audio rendered from Felucca's presets, with thanks to Leo Kuroshita.
